title: CFPC Tools Permitted Set Contract
description: Declares which tools a µ or task is permitted to invoke. Separate from <tool> catalog-only entries. Advisory or Enforced mode.

@id.description: Unique identifier for this permitted set contract.

@permitted.description: Tool IDs this contract permits. Empty array = zero-access (valid).

mode.description: advisory (default): violations logged but not blocked. enforced: violations block execution.
